verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs explicitly state the exact story: 'Keep the same primitives at every scale... The API you start with is the API you keep,' backed by Fly Machines scaling from single-VM boot to tens of thousands of instances using the same primitive. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that no rearchitecting/migration is needed as apps scale, and concrete case studies showing prototype-to-massive-scale continuity; community evidence instead focuses on reliability/outage issues rather than confirming or refuting the API-consistency claim.
